killedBy: devMenuView: the round trip that makes the preview honest reports unknown parameters, which name no control at all
why: Breaks the round trip that makes the preview honest: the state would be explained from a DIFFERENT string than the one Apply navigates to, so a page's own query is previewed as absent and then carried anyway. Acceptance criterion 4 is exactly that the two cannot diverge, and they can only be guaranteed identical by being the same string. The case that catches it is the unknown-parameter one: with the base dropped from the EXPLAIN side, a parameter the page carried is previewed as absent while the URL still carries it.
